verdict: Strong organic presence this period; GBP engagement softening week over week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your two locations generated 4,073 actions through Google Business Profile — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — with no paid advertising running. GBP engagement dipped 17.53% in the most recent week compared to the prior week, which is consistent with organic traffic softening when there is no paid activity driving additional visibility. The October 27 action count reads zero, but that reflects a data collection delay, not an actual drop in engagement. Canton continues to outperform on call rate (1.11% vs. Fishers' 0.65%), and we're monitoring the Fishers profile to understand the gap between its higher impression volume and lower call conversion.
